correctness.rationale: The full six-compartment system has stable demographic totals with unique N1=N2=1 equilibrium. Exact reduction gives F(x,r) and lower endemic z_-=(1/30,1/70). The Jacobian A has determinant -13/30 and a simple positive eigenvalue lambda_+, producing a simple antisymmetric zero crossing at d*=lambda_+/2. The mean/difference equations are exactly quadratic; their Lyapunov–Schmidt solvability yields eta=-166845/52+26656035 sqrt(26689)/1387828<0. Nonzero eta proves the subcritical local pitchfork and unique exchanged asymmetric pair for d<d*. Simple noncentral spectra prove one unstable direction on each asymmetric branch, and two-to-one unstable-direction exchange on the diagonal. The standalone verify.py establishes critical algebra exactly. Numerical checks are not asserted as infinite proofs; no global claims.

value.rationale: The original epidemic framework makes migration-controlled endemic multiplicity central. This theorem establishes a sharp nontrivial transition specifically in low-prevalence saddle structure: two exchanged asymmetric saddles meet a synchronized saddle at an algebraic migration threshold, with signed nonlinear orientation, positive-state feasibility and changed unstable dimension. Such saddles can shape extinction/endemic basin boundaries, though basin geometry itself is not claimed. These conclusions are not a routine eigenvalue restatement; cubic sign and branch existence require nonlinear mean feedback.
